March 9, 2018 - By Richard Conner 
Wilbanks Smith & Thomas Asset Management Llc increased its stake in Kinder Morgan (KMI) by 16.47% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Wilbanks Smith & Thomas Asset Management Llc bought 18,217 shares as the company’s stock declined 10.34% while stock markets rallied. The institutional investor held 128,793 shares of the public utilities company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $2.47 million, up from 110,576 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Wilbanks Smith & Thomas Asset Management Llc who had been investing in Kinder Morgan for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $35.81 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.37% or $0.22 during the last trading session, reaching $16.23. About 1.96 million shares traded. Kinder Morgan, Inc. (NYSE:KMI) has risen 13.09% since March 9, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 3.61% the S&P500. 
Botty Investors Llc increased its stake in Dorchester Minerals Lp (DMLP) by 27.67% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Botty Investors Llc bought 39,348 shares as the company’s stock declined 1.48% while stock markets rallied. The institutional investor held 181,536 shares of the energy company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $2.73M, up from 142,188 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Botty Investors Llc who had been investing in Dorchester Minerals Lp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $508.41 million market cap company. It closed at $15.75 lastly. It is down 34.09% since March 9, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 17.39% the S&P500. 
Wilbanks Smith & Thomas Asset Management Llc, which manages about $2.31 billion and $1.19 billion US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Adobe Systems (NASDAQ:ADBE) by 4,240 shares to 26,501 shares, valued at $3.95 million in 2017Q3, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Guggenheim S&P 500 Pure Gr (RPG) by 3,930 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 95,601 shares, and cut its stake in Guggenheim S&P 500 Ew (RSP).
